AppBlocks.description: AppBlocks and its companion packages. Every setting is optional.

NoStorePages.description: Pages for which AppBlocks sets no-store and prevents output-cache storage: those with a block whose output depends on who asks, every page, or none. API cache headers are independent.

ApiRoot.description: Where the forms, attachments and tabular endpoints and the antiforgery token endpoint answer, and the path below which a request is treated as an API request (401 and 403 rather than login redirects). Pages with blocks carry it in an appblocks-api-root meta tag.

MaxRouteSegments.description: The most segments an API endpoint's route may have.

AdministratorGroups.description: Aliases of backoffice User groups admitted beside Umbraco's Administrators to AppBlocks' Settings screens and the AppBlocks.Administrator policy. The Backing Classes section has its own CodeEditorGroups.

CodeDirectory.description: The Backing Classes folder, relative to the content root unless rooted. Keep it equal to the AppBlocksCodeDirectory MSBuild property.

CodeEditorGroups.description: Aliases of backoffice User groups allowed to use the Backing Classes section, beside Administrators.

DataRoot.description: The folder whose App_Data holds AppBlocks' settings files and fallback database files. The site's content root when not set.

MaxBodySize.description: The largest form submission, in bytes. A larger one is answered 413.

DataSources.description: Limits of the SQL data source engine.

CommandTimeoutSeconds.description: How long a data source statement may run before it is cancelled and answered 503; 0 waits without limit.

MaxChanges.description: The most row changes one tabular save, or one block's rows in a form's save, may carry.

ReceiptLifetimeMinutes.description: How long a create's receipt is kept, so a retried request returns the record it created instead of inserting it again.

ReceiptCapacity.description: How many receipts the default in-memory store holds before it drops expired ones. A load-balanced site registers a shared IDataSourceReceiptStore.

MaxRows.description: The most rows any Tabular form block lists for one record; a block's own row limit is cut to it.

MaxDays.description: The most days a window of day columns spans.

MaxHourDays.description: The most days a window of hour columns spans.

MaxRows.description: The most rows a schedule reads.

MaxBars.description: The most bars a schedule reads.

WeekendDays.description: The days a schedule shades as the weekend. Saturday and Sunday when not set.

AntiSpam.description: Anti-spam keys, which the settings screen cannot change, by service: turnstile, recaptchaV2, recaptchaV3, hcaptcha or a registered service's alias.

VerifyHostname.description: Refuse a token the service says was solved on another host than the one the form was sent to. Turn off behind a proxy that hides the public host, or with a service's test keys.

SiteKey.description: The service's public site key, used where a block leaves its own empty.

ReportAdministratorGroups.description: AppBlocks.InteractiveReports: aliases of backoffice User groups granted report administration, beside Administrators and Interactive Reports Administrator.

IncludeBackOfficeReports.description: AppBlocks.InteractiveReports: enables the optional backoffice reports.

PaperSizes.description: AppBlocks.InteractiveReports: the paper sizes the Print dialog offers, in order, the first chosen to start with. A4, Letter and Legal when not set.

Pressroom.description: A Pressroom PDF configuration used until configurations are saved in the backoffice.

TimeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for Pressroom, in seconds.

AllowedAssetHosts.description: Host names, addresses and CIDR ranges a document may embed assets from although they are loopback, link-local or private-network addresses, which are refused otherwise.

AllowAllTemplates.description: Add every installed template to the Document type's allowed templates. False leaves the type's templates to the site.

PrintStylesheet.description: The stylesheet placed first in every document by the default presentation; empty for none.

Connection.description: The registered connection whose database holds uploaded files. AttachmentsDb selects a separate store.

MaxFileSize.description: The largest file any Attachments block accepts, in bytes.

AllowedExtensions.description: Extensions such as .pdf every block is limited to. Empty allows any, and each block chooses its own.

RetentionDays.description: How many days a removed file stays before an administrator's purge deletes it.

PendingLifetimeHours.description: How many hours a file uploaded before its form's record was saved waits for that save.
